label: Necessary-being node, GOD_NAMING_2 reading: the reference-fixed divine name designates necessarily
paraphrase: Necessary-being node under the reference-fixed (rigid) reading of the name 'God': some actual root n (concrete, existing at w, with no actual concrete ground) is GOD_4, the one GOD_4, with the classical attributes, and at every world accessible from w the name 'God', whose bearer is fixed at w as the unique existing GOD_4, designates something (strict co-designation of the name with itself). The name designates n at a world exactly when n exists there, whether or not n satisfies any description there. Logically equivalent to STMT-NECESSARY-ROOT-BOX-K (rigidIffBoxK).
